action: No action needed beyond confirming your Apple services work again. If sign-in or Apple Pay still fails, check Apple's system status page before changing passwords or settings.
exec: A vendor-side change briefly disrupted widely used Apple services; the company ruled out a cyber cause.
plain: Apple services including iCloud sign-in, the App Store, Apple Music and Apple Pay had problems on November 17. Apple said an internal update caused it and that it was not a cyberattack.
summary: Users reported problems on November 17 with iCloud sign-in, the App Store, Apple Music, AppleCare and Apple Pay. Apple said an internal update caused the outages and that many systems were back up, with work continuing on the rest; later reports said most were restored. Outlets citing Fox Business say Apple ruled out a cyberattack. Cyber cause: ruled out.
title: Apple outage hits iCloud sign-in, App Store and Apple Pay

validation.note: Company statement carried by two outlets.
